response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced full-stack engineer with a strong general software craftsmanship background, but his recent work history is dominated by TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, and web/mobile stacks, with no evidence of Java/Kotlin/Spring/JVM tooling or IDE internals experience. The role requires deep JVM expertise and enterprise framework knowledge (Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate) plus genuine interest in IDE internals, none of which are demonstrated here despite brief, dated Java exposure (robotic arms, C IDE work in C/C++).
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level experience across many companies and domains, showing adaptability and strong engineering fundamentals
Demonstrated experience building developer tools, testing frameworks, and even a C-based IDE (NI LabWindows/CVI)
Strong communication skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and community teaching
concerns: No recent or substantial experience with Java, Kotlin, or the Spring ecosystem — core requirements for this role
No demonstrated deep JVM expertise; most backend work is in Node.js, TypeScript, or DLang instead
No direct experience with IDE internals or language tooling beyond a brief C/C++ IDE component role in 2014-2015

key_factors.factor: Strong general engineering seniority and craftsmanship
